summary: The order-update connection through the relay: order packets (no exchange: found by the instrument id) open, partly filled, complete, rejected with its reason, cancelled and trigger pending, and a trade packet for a fill, reported complete for that fill with the traded price.

notes: Order and trade topics are prod/updates/order/v1/<client id> and prod/updates/trade/v1/<client id>; the relay subscribes them itself, so the feed sends no sub frame.
